# harvester_kubeovn_iptables_dnat_rule (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Port 8022 of the EIP is forwarded to the SSH port of a VM of the subnet.
resource "harvester_kubeovn_iptables_dnat_rule" "example" {
  name          = "my-dnat-rule"
  eip           = harvester_kubeovn_iptables_eip.example.name
  external_port = "8022"
  protocol      = "tcp"
  internal_ip   = "10.0.0.100"
  internal_port = "22"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `eip` (String) Name of the iptables EIP whose address receives the traffic.
- `external_port` (String) Port of the EIP the traffic arrives on.
- `internal_ip` (String) Address in the VPC the traffic is forwarded to.
- `internal_port` (String) Port of internal_ip the traffic is forwarded to.
- `name` (String) A unique name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the forwarded traffic, tcp or udp.
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `status_external_port` (String) External port applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_internal_ip` (String) Internal address applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_internal_port` (String) Internal port applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_nat_gw_dp` (String) NAT gateway the rule is applied in.
- `status_protocol` (String) Protocol applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_v4_ip` (String) IPv4 address of the EIP applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_v6_ip` (String) IPv6 address of the EIP applied by kube-ovn.
